maria: Quick check-in: want to show effective SLO + who controls notifications on route cards. Low-risk but need API + telemetry instrumented.
ben: Fine but defaults matter. We should expose effective_threshold only, not raw tenant policy.
kai: Mock link: https://redwood.internal/figma/slo-card-mini (private). UI: show a small "source" chip (tenant|org|route).
trina: Telemetry ask: emit events for surface_show and for suppressed vs emitted alerts: pre_suppress_count, post_suppress_count, sample_rate. Need reason codes for suppression.
maria: API suggestion: keep notify routing separate from noise controls. Server returns effective_threshold, source, notify_controlled flag, and optional edit_blob for the editor.
ben: Rollout: server-read fields first (2 weeks), then readonly UI 5% canary, check alert_volume_delta & suppressed_ratio. Pause if >10% spike.
kai: I'll update mocks with provenance and suppressed indicator.
trina: I'll draft gating queries and the suppression reasons list.
maria: Thanks 44d - RFC next week.
